Chapter 941: Chapter 7: Taiyuan Relic (Please Subscribe)

Gazing at the ‘meteor’ rushing toward him, Lin Yuan’s eyes shone brightly.

Though the Chaos Void contains countless opportunities, it is extremely rare, like in Lin Yuan’s case, to have fortune hurl itself at him not long after beginning his exploration.

It is indeed exceedingly uncommon.

Since the birth of the universe where human civilization resides, there have been numerous occasions where treasures and rare legacies have fallen from the Eternal Spatial Rift.

That is because the universe itself, within the depths of the Chaos Void, is akin to a massive celestial body, invisibly influencing the space-time of the vast surrounding area.

Any object passing nearby will be drawn by the universe’s own gravity, eventually falling through the Eternal Spatial Rift into the universe.

Given the enormous size of the universe and the passage of enough time, it is only normal for it to ‘net’ some of the treasures drifting in its vicinity.

But Lin Yuan?

Compared to the Main Universe, he is far too insignificant, making the probability of randomly encountering such a treasure incredibly low.

“According to the trajectory of this ‘meteor’, it will pass close to the Main Universe.”

“At that time, it might be influenced by the Main Universe and, after billions of years, plummet into one of the Eternal Spatial Rifts, becoming an opportunity descended from outside the universe?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that, in some ways, he was now intercepting the ultimate opportunities within the Main Universe.

“Let’s try to stop it ahead of time.”

Lin Yuan carefully observed the ‘meteor’, “There are flows of formation energy. This ‘meteor’ must be the dwelling of some powerful being.”

It is true that in the Chaos Void, there are naturally occurring powerful formations.

But the might of these types of killing formations is extraordinarily great, and the formation energy within the ‘meteor’ is far inferior to those spawned by chaos.

Therefore, Lin Yuan deduced that this meteor is likely the dwelling of some formidable entity, as formations laid out by hand are typically used as dwellings.

“The owner of the dwelling must be gone.”

Lin Yuan drew more conclusions, if the owner of the dwelling were still there, he wouldn’t be able to see this ‘meteor’ at all. Any dwelling would certainly value secrecy and would usually be tucked deep within multiple layers of space-time.

Even those rare moving dwellings would try their best to conceal their aura. The Chaos Void might hold countless opportunities, but it also contains many dangers.

During his exploration, this avatar of Lin Yuan was also extremely cautious.

The onrushing ‘meteor’, with its aura exposed, shows that it is not being controlled by anyone.

“The vortex of space-time…”

With a flicker of thought, Lin Yuan started to perceive the Seventh Realm of space-time, attempting to halt the ‘meteor’ on its predicted path.

As an avatar, there’s not much Lin Yuan can do. To directly block the ‘meteor’? At its current speed, Lin Yuan’s avatar would likely be instantly obliterated upon impact.

He could only attempt indirect obstruction, influencing the ‘meteor’ as it flew along its path.

This method wouldn’t stop the ‘meteor’ quickly, but it can effectively slow it down, which is quite safe.

“The speed has decreased…”

Lin Yuan felt certain, his biggest concern being that the current attempts of using the space-time vortex would not affect the ‘meteor’ much.

But now, it seems the effect is quite significant.

It is also because the Power of Space-Time controlled by Lin Yuan’s Seventh Realm is abundant.

If it were those at the Twelve-Star ultimate level within the Main Universe, relying only on the intuition of the Sixth Realm of space-time.

The influence on the ‘meteor’ would be much less.

“According to the current rate, at most in half a day, the ‘meteor’ will come to a complete halt.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, swiftly controlling the Power of Space-Time to obstruct the ‘meteor’.

Half a day later.

The swiftly approaching ‘meteor’ gradually slowed down and finally came to a gentle stop before Lin Yuan.

Standing nearby, Lin Yuan could finally see the full view of the ‘meteor’, which is a massive island with a diameter exceeding ten million miles from the outside.

In the center of the island stands a palace, surrounded by rolling mountains and continuous lakes.

“Eighteen Twelve-Star mystical trees?” Lin Yuan noticed at once, nearby the Central Palace, trees with the aura of Twelve-Star level swaying in the breeze.

The fruits growing on the branches emitted powerful energetic auras.

“Struck gold.” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Compared to Twelve-Star weapons materials and such, these Twelve-Star mystical trees that can bear Spirit Fruit are akin to money trees, producing highly valuable Spirit Fruit at regular intervals.

Besides these eighteen mystical trees, the island itself is also a rare material. Even though it is just at the threshold of the Twelve-Star level, the quantity is substantial – a full ten million miles in circumference.

“The control core of this dwelling should be within that palace.”

Lin Yuan paid no heed to the eighteen mystical trees surrounding the palace; the remnants of space-time power near these trees were likely left by the owner of the dwelling.

The simplest way to get past these space-time barriers is to refine the control core of the island, thus the entire island would fall under Lin Yuan’s control.

“Let’s go.”

Lin Yuan split himself in two. Being an avatar formed from Chaos Qi, as long as he split off another sliver of spiritual will, he easily created a new avatar.

Without knowing whether there were dangers within the palace, it was natural for Lin Yuan to make an extra preparation.

Whoosh!

The avatar Lin Yuan had split off descended onto the island, making its way toward the Central Palace.

“This palace does not seem to have any obstructions.” Lin Yuan sized up the palace, cautiously observed for a while, and then walked in.

The palace was vast, and Lin Yuan swiftly toured it, finally arriving at a certain inner temple.

Here a twelve-edged Crystal Stone was suspended, seemingly the convergence point of the entire giant island’s energy.
